info.title: AusAware API
info.description:
Live and recent public-safety data for Australia — fire and emergency incidents, warnings and hazards — as AusAware relays it from the agencies' own public feeds.

**Keys.** Every feed needs an API key (the reference and service endpoints are public), sent as `X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Request one from your profile at nswpsn.forcequit.xyz (API keys); staff choose what it may read. Keys are for scripts and servers — a request carrying a browser `Origin` header is refused.

**Scopes.** A key reads an endpoint when its scopes cover the endpoint's source, type and window — listed on each operation as `x-scopes`. This document shows the public endpoints and the ones your key's scopes reach.

**Responses.** GeoJSON endpoints answer with a bare FeatureCollection. Everything else answers `{ "data": … }`. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` with a stable `code`.

AusAware is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or acting for any agency whose data it carries; the data is theirs, as published.

id.description: The feed's own id for the record. On /traffic/works, an id made from the record's position, title and category instead, because that feed issues new ids each time it is rebuilt

type.description: Which feed the record came from: Incident, Roadwork, Flood, Fire, Major Event, Alpine or Council. On /traffic/works, the record's eventCategory (else its eventType, else Works)

incidentType.description: The kind of incident named at the start of the title, upper case (CRASH, BREAKDOWN, HAZARD, FLOODING, ROADWORK, …); empty when the title starts with none of them

mainCategory.description: The feed's own category, e.g. CRASH or SCHEDULED ROADWORK. On /traffic/works, its eventCategory (Roadwork, Flood, generalHazards, …)

subCategory.description: The feed's sub-category (its subCategoryA, else subCategoryB) as published — sometimes the text "null"

subcategory.description: A filter key: incidentType, else mainCategory. On /traffic/works: mainCategory, else incidentKind

incidentKind.description: As the hazard feeds give it — Planned or Unplanned in the samples seen. On /traffic/works, the record's eventType

title.description: The headline, else the title, else the display name, with a leading incidentType taken off when enough is left to stand as a title

otherAdvice.description: Plain text (the HTML the feed writes is removed): the feed's otherAdvice, else its adviceA

adviceB.description: Plain text (the HTML the feed writes is removed)

roads.description: The affected roads, each as "street suburb", separated by "; " (or the feed's own text, where it gives the roads as text)

affectedDirection.description: From the record's first road: its affectedDirection, else its conditionTendency — empty in the hazard feeds as currently published

impactedLanes.description: From the record's first road: its impactedLanes, where the feed gives them as a list

speedLimit.description: As the feed gives it, written as text; "-1" or empty where it sets none

expectedDelay.description: The feed's expectedDelay (else delay), written as text; "-1" or empty where there is none

encodedPolyline.description: The first line in encodedPolylines, or empty

coords.description: The line as an encoded polyline, as the feed gives it

direction.description: As the feed gives it, e.g. BOTH_DIRECTIONS

lastUpdated.description: When the record was last updated (else its end). On the hazard feeds, unix milliseconds written as a string; on /traffic/works, ISO 8601. Empty when the feed has none

start.description: On the hazard feeds, unix milliseconds written as a string; on /traffic/works, ISO 8601. Empty when the feed has none

end.description: On the hazard feeds, unix milliseconds written as a string; on /traffic/works, ISO 8601. Empty when the feed has none

get.summary: Stations and stops in an area
get.description: Train, metro, light-rail, tram and ferry stops inside an area, for one region, from AnyTrip — bus stops are not included. The area is clamped to the region's coverage and widened outward to a 0.01° grid; after clamping it may span at most 2.5° each way, and an area outside the region is refused. At most 500 stops. Each area's answer is cached for an hour and can be up to a day old.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: au2 NSW (the default), au3 Victoria, au4 South East Queensland, au5 Adelaide, au9 the ACT; any other value is refused

parameters.name: minLat
parameters.description: Southern edge of the area, degrees latitude

parameters.name: maxLat
parameters.description: Northern edge of the area, degrees latitude

parameters.name: minLon
parameters.description: Western edge of the area, degrees longitude

parameters.name: maxLon
parameters.description: Eastern edge of the area, degrees longitude

parameters.name: modes
parameters.description: Comma-separated modes — au2 metro, sydneytrains, nswtrains, ferries, lightrail; au3 metrotrains, vlinetrains, tram; au4 trains, ferries, lightrail; au5 trains, lightrail; au9 lightrail. All of them when absent; an unknown one is refused. No region offers bus stops
